name: app-6a91fca0d4548191bbeef95e1e574517
description: Find the moments that matter in your videos and turn them into useful notes and clips.

interface.longDescription: Turn lectures, interviews, and recordings into useful notes and clips. VideoVector helps students, editors, and creators find the moments they need, with timestamps and downloads.
defaultPrompt: Turn this lecture into study notes with timestamps.
Find the clearest explanation in this video.
Find useful moments in my interview for a short clip.

prompts: Turn this lecture into study notes with timestamps.
Find three useful moments in this video for a short recap.
Show my latest video analysis and let me download the results.
review.commerce_description: VideoVector offers subscriptions and processing credits purchased on its website. The plugin uses the linked VideoVector account and its available credits; it does not collect payments or complete purchases in ChatGPT.

positive.description: Attach a lecture video in a new conversation. Ask: “Turn this lecture into study notes with simple explanations and timestamps.”
positive.prompt: Turn this lecture into study notes with simple explanations and timestamps.
positive.expected_behavior: Organized study notes covering the lecture’s main ideas, with simple explanations and timestamps for the relevant sections.

positive.description: Attach a meeting recording in a new conversation. Ask: “Give me meeting notes with the main decisions and action items, including owners and deadlines.”
positive.prompt: Give me meeting notes with the main decisions and action items, including owners and deadlines.
positive.expected_behavior: Clear meeting notes listing the main decisions and action items. Owners and deadlines are included when mentioned; any unstated details are identified as unspecified.

positive.description: Attach a documentary video in a new conversation. Ask: “Summarize this documentary’s main subjects and important events, with timestamps.”
positive.prompt: Summarize this documentary’s main subjects and important events, with timestamps.
positive.expected_behavior: A concise overview of the documentary’s main subjects and important events, with timestamps for notable sections.

positive.description: Attach a video or audio recording in a new conversation. Ask: “Add this recording to VideoVector for later. Don’t analyze it yet.”
positive.prompt: Add this recording to VideoVector for later. Don’t analyze it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirmation that the recording was added. The reviewer can find it in VideoVector; no summary or analysis is presented.

positive.description: Use an account that already has an analyzed video. In a new conversation, replace [video name] with its title and [topic] with a topic it covers. Ask: “Find my older analysis of [video name]. What does it say about [topic]?”
positive.prompt: Find my older analysis of [video name]. What does it say about [topic]?
positive.expected_behavior: The matching video is identified by name. The reviewer receives a clear answer about the requested topic, based on the earlier analysis, with relevant timestamps and a link to the results.

negative.description: Ask: “Add music and animated captions to this video and render a finished version.” The reviewer sees a clear explanation that VideoVector cannot add music or captions or render an edited video.
negative.prompt: Add music and animated captions to this video and render a finished version.

negative.description: Ask: “Post this clip to my Instagram and TikTok accounts.” The reviewer sees a clear explanation that VideoVector cannot publish to social media accounts.
negative.prompt: Post this clip to my Instagram and TikTok accounts.

negative.description: Ask: “Join my Zoom meeting tomorrow and record it.” The reviewer sees a clear explanation that VideoVector cannot join or record a future meeting.
negative.prompt: Join my Zoom meeting tomorrow and record it.

publication.release_notes: 7.0.1: Aligns the plugin with the five-tool MCP server. Every extraction includes segment and whole-media fields in one call, with content-aware boundaries for audio and video. Analysis automatically saves prompts for reuse; ordinary questions use extracted content in context, search filters existing results, and import transfers media without starting extraction. Keeps exact Studio links, native attachments, and available downloads.
